thread:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from the security segment — collecting live Qs so we can assign owners and timelines.
Sanjay Patel: First, BYOK scope — can Private VPC customers bring their own keys, and what's the rough ETA?
Alex Rivera: Also need clarity on audit log exports: default retention, enterprise options, and export SLAs.
Jess Liu: ISO readiness question: are we doing a parallel certification effort or piggybacking off SOC2 artifacts?
Sanjay Patel: BYOK plan: Private/VPC BYOK supported in Q3 for customer-managed KMS; hosted BYOK requires HSM integration and aims for Q4, pending SOC2 re-eval. I'll publish gating checklist.
Tyler Nguyen: Proposed audit retention tiers: default 90d, enterprise up to 7y with export hooks to S3/GCS. Export SLA: standard 24h, enterprise expedited 4h (pre-approved).
Cory Brooks: Legal note: EU PII exports need DP review; include privacy team before customer commitments.
Alex Rivera: Draft audit export schema example (JSONL):
{"ts":"2026-03-23T16:22:10Z","request_id":"req_abc123","actor":"svc:acme","route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood/gpt-13b","tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":210,"outcome":"success","ip":"10.2.3.4","kms_key_id":"projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"}
Jess Liu: ISO scope will map to SOC2 controls but adds supplier assessments and supply-chain risk. I'll create a gap matrix.
Sanjay Patel: Key rotation: runtime will support rewrap calls and lease boundaries so rotations are online; we'll run integration tests to validate no downtime.
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) @Sanjay publish BYOK timeline + gating checklist (EOD next Tue). 2) @Alex draft audit-export schema + retention pricing. 3) @Jess own ISO readiness/gap matrix (by Fri). 4) @Tyler draft SLA/KPI copy for external comms.
engops-bot: CI: private-kms-integration branch merged to staging at 2359991270 — smoke tests passing :white_check_mark:
Alex Rivera: I'll push the schema draft to the docs repo and tag security + privacy.
Cory Brooks: Heads-up: include cost estimate for long-tail retention and export egress in pricing notes.
Tyler Nguyen: For SLAs suggestion: p99 <= 350ms for small hosted models; error budget 0.1%/month; audit export SLAs as above.
Maria Chen: Thanks team — flagging legal/privacy for review before any customer-facing statements. Drop follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
